summary.headline: The plan is approved, and we are clearing the fixes that everything else depends on.
summary.body: Your account now uses your own domain for logins and links, its time zone is set to Eastern, and your website loads at www.flretirementsolutions.com. Next up: business texting registration, your newsletter in GHL (first issue Nov 24, after your approval), and moving client data out of CRM Boost.
summary.needs_you: Pick which recorded video becomes your free agent training, and send the recordings you haven't published yet.
summary.next_call: Thu, Oct 29 at 3 PM ET (2 PM CT)

tasks.task: Digital Unicorns login to your GHL account
tasks.note: We work under our own login, so changes are easy to trace.

tasks.task: Logins and email links use your own domain
Company name set to Florida Retirement Solutions
Account time zone set to Eastern
tasks.note: Appointments and emails now follow Miami time, including daylight saving.

tasks.task: Website loads at www.flretirementsolutions.com
Website loads without the www
tasks.note: A DNS setting is still blocking it.

tasks.task: Domain set to renew automatically
Business texting registration
tasks.note: Carrier approval takes 2 to 4 weeks. We will ask you for your business tax ID to finish it.

tasks.task: Pause old automations before importing data
Review of your roomvu account
Decision: move newsletter and posts into GHL
tasks.note: Listings are dropped. roomvu gets cancelled before its Jan 27 renewal.

tasks.task: Decision: who approves, and which languages
tasks.note: Your team approves. Newsletter in English and Spanish.

tasks.task: Newsletter design in GHL with your disclaimer
AI content assistant that drafts each issue
tasks.note: Every issue comes to you for approval. Nothing sends on its own.

tasks.task: First newsletter sent from GHL
Social posts move to GHL
Export roomvu data and cancel
tasks.note: We will remind you and prepare the exports.

tasks.task: Test move of 5 client records
tasks.note: Maria checks them before the rest move.

tasks.task: Move clients, leads and notes from CRM Boost
tasks.note: No SSNs or full policy numbers come over.

tasks.task: DROP list follow-up starting 6 months before each date
New-client thank-you and anniversary reminders
tasks.note: Starts with your most recent new client.

tasks.task: GHL booking calendar to replace Calendly
tasks.note: Calls on set days only, with your intake form before booking.

tasks.task: Appointment reminders and no-show follow-up
tasks.note: Reminders 24 hours, 1 hour, 30 minutes and 5 minutes before.

tasks.task: AI phone assistant and missed-call text back
Lead and client follow-up journeys
Brand voice from your interviews and videos
Your own domain and GHL sub-account
Free agent training funnel, English and Spanish
tasks.note: Starts once you pick the video.

Links to your YouTube videos
